LESSON: ANIMALS ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL
Topic 3.2: Animals ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Animals ENVIRONMENT
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify domestic and wild animals
2. describe how some animals move or feed
3. practise kind safe care of animals

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Types of animals

Teach
• Domestic animals live with people.
• Wild animals live on their own.

Worked example
• Domestic: cow, goat, sheep, chicken, dog, cat.
• Wild: lion, zebra, elephant, giraffe, fish in lakes/rivers.

Try this
• Sort: dog, lion, chicken, zebra → domestic or wild?
• (Check later: dog/chicken domestic; lion/zebra wild)

▸ Care and safety

Teach
• Be kind to animals.
• Do not touch unknown animals.
• Wash hands after handling pets/farm animals.

Worked example
• Good care: give a dog clean water and food.
• Safety: do not put your hand near a strange dog’s mouth.

Try this
• Write 2 kind actions and 1 safety rule for animals.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Cow = domestic
• Lion = wild
• Wash hands after touching animals

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 5 domestic and 5 wild animals found in Kenya.
2. Draw one animal and label how it moves.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Visit/observe one animal area safely with an adult. Write 5 facts.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Domestic vs wild
• Be kind
• Stay safe

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
